claim_one_line: THE PUNCTURE CHARACTERS, SEALED (sL-10 item 15; sm:B1535's Corollary C3, first place): on every fibre-direction cover M_{D,w} with 2 <= ∣D∣ <= 12 of m004 (5), m003 (9), m136 (29) and m135 (37), at every character non-trivial on a puncture (fibre part of order dividing m(C); 2,406,622 characters in 662,988 Galois orbits; every root of unity s), does the line's interior supply n reach 2 (Part L, routes W exact, P mod two primes, T the transfer), and at every member over such a character is the four's supply capL2 >= 2 too (Part F, routes R and P4)? By Theorem C with Lemmas 2 and W', room for two generations on M_{D,w} needs exactly that. Proposition H (the quaternion line): on every state's (Z/2)^2 cover, at the character zeta_H that cuts out the Q8 cover, the line's supply sums to 4 over the roots of unity, is at most 2 at any s where the monodromy moves Q8, and is even where it fixes Q8; sealed as P9-P11, P9 the run's positive control. Controls K0-K12 hold on banked, literature and design-time data; a population-wide prediction is certified only on records complete against K11's manifest and every planned Part F reading, its fourth roots certified by brute force (the audit lane's R87 and R89). Eleven predictions with priors (expected 8.23; P4-P8 revised before the seal, the draft's values shown); NEGATIVE (scoped) if P1-P3, P9 and P8 hold. No outcome has been read. 0 of 19.
